title: Hinomori Shiho — The Answer I Found〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (How did I let Saki and others find out about Iori wanting me to join her band...?)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Even after they said that they want to keep playing together...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Again, I appreciate the thought, but that's just not enough...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You have to be willing to put everything on the line to become a pro.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Can you say for sure that you'd be able to do that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They all had to stop and think about it...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But I shouldn't be surprised either. I'm the only one that's been wanting to go pro...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They don't want the same thing that I do...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I knew that and I still...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (This is gonna be harder than I thought it would be...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They still mean that much to me...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (How many times have I gone through this in my mind? I'm never able to come up with an answer...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shiho, is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Minori? What is it...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um, you seem a little different than usual so...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I do? I was just thinking about something.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, okay... But...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku's been pretty worried about you too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
M-My sister?
What are you talking about...?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hinomori's been standing there for so long now. What's going on?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: You're right. But even when she looks worried, she's really cute.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: D-Do I have to...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes. Please go and talk to her.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I don't have a choice, do I? The entire class is getting restless, and people are starting to gather outside too...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii! You finally saw me!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, right. Let's go somewhere else with fewer prying eyes.
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So what brought you all the way down to my class...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's that...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii, you haven't looked well at all lately and I was wondering if you've been getting enough sleep...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd rather sit down and talk about this with you at home, but I have practice in the morning and you're always out rehearsing until late so...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is this about your band...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, yes...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Just to be clear, it's not like we're fighting right now or anything...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I know. That's not what concerns me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's just that, whenever something happens between you and your friends, you always start avoiding me, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The same thing happened before Saki came back to school. I mean, we happen to be talking right now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I understand that you want to say that there's nothing going on and everything is fine.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Just, do you remember what we talked about that other time here?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I think you should talk it out with Honami and the others if you can.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure they'll understand if you decide to be honest with them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I remember...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The timing might not have worked out quite right, but I think I was able to say what I needed to say...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But that also probably hurt a little too...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure everything will work out.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll find an answer that Honami and the others will be satisfied with...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I hope so...
